text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Trainer! Thanks for giving me some time off.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I spent yesterday hanging out in the dorm's common area, which I haven't been able to do for a while.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: It was able to show my appreciation for everything the staff does for us by helping clean the dorm and pitching in with dinner!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Thanks to that, I'm fully fired up and ready to tackle today's training with all I've got!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like Kitasan Black made good use of her day off and is feeling nice and refreshed.
